findings.evidence: grep of the pinned Mathlib: `completeEquivSelf` is defined at Completion.lean:372 and referenced nowhere else; no `Completion S ≃+* S` exists, so only the bijectivity — not the ring structure — is the duplicated part.
findings.fix: Define `selfRingEquiv := RingEquiv.ofBijective (extensionHom (RingHom.id S) continuous_id) (UniformCompletion.completeEquivSelf (α := S)).bijective`, keeping only `selfRingEquiv_coe` (which is `extensionHom_coe`) as the simp lemma; the hand-rolled `RingEquiv.ofRingHom` proof of the second composite then goes away.
findings.issue: The bijectivity content of `selfRingEquiv` is already in Mathlib: `UniformCompletion.completeEquivSelf [CompleteSpace α] [T0Space α] : Completion α ≃ᵤ α` (`Mathlib/Topology/UniformSpace/Completion.lean:371-373`). The PR instead reproves both composites by hand with `Completion.ext`/density. The underlying maps coincide: `Completion.extension f = cPkg.extend f` (`Completion.lean:429-430`), `AbstractCompletion.compare pkg pkg' = pkg.extend pkg'.coe` (`AbstractCompletion.lean:258-259`), and `ofComplete` is `mk α id ...` (`AbstractCompletion.lean:88`), while `extensionHom f hf` has `toFun := Completion.extension f` (`Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/UniformRing.lean:129-134`).

summary: The new `CompleteSpace` instance for discrete uniformities is a verbatim duplicate of Mathlib's instance in `Mathlib/Topology/UniformSpace/Cauchy.lean:471`, which the file already imports; its proof also re-derives Mathlib's `DiscreteUniformity.eq_pure_of_cauchy`. Secondarily, `selfRingEquiv`'s bijectivity argument reproves `UniformCompletion.completeEquivSelf`. The rest of the PR is new and reuses existing API.
